command.start.title: Open Visualizer
command.annotateArray.title: Annotate Dynamic Array (v@n)
command.startServer.title: Open Visualizer in Browser
config.dynamicArrays.markdownDescription: Length annotations for pointers to heap arrays, written `pointer@length` or `function:pointer@length`. Both sides are evaluated in the paused frame, and the length may be a literal.
config.rootFilter.markdownDescription: When not empty, only variables with these names are used as roots of the graph.
config.limits.maxNodes.markdownDescripti: Maximum number of nodes read in one snapshot. Reaching it marks the snapshot as truncated.
config.limits.maxEdges.markdownDescripti: Maximum number of edges read in one snapshot. Reaching it marks the snapshot as truncated.
config.limits.maxCells.markdownDescripti: Maximum number of elements read per array.
config.limits.historyDepth.markdownDescr: Number of pauses kept for the history slider.
config.view.markdownDescription: Internal view state of the DebugAlgo panel, saved per debugged file. Written by the panel; not meant to be edited by hand.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: DebugAlgo runs Python inside the debugger of the workspace's debug sessions, so it is disabled in Restricted Mode.
